en: I shopped at the big market yesterday.
I didn't shop today because I am sick.
You shopped well in the morning.
Why didn't you shop with your father?
You (f.) shopped quickly yesterday.
You (f.) didn't shop for the house yesterday.
He shopped from the old medina.
My father didn't shop yesterday.
My sister shopped at the market early.
She didn't shop for the party.
We shopped for the Eid yesterday.
We didn't shop this week.
You (pl.) shopped from the Sunday market.
You (pl.) didn't shop with your money.
The parents shopped early in the morning.
They didn't shop for dinner.
I shop every Tuesday.
I don't shop from these shops.
You always shop at night.
Why don't you shop with us?
You (f.) shop every Saturday.

lat: nti ma kattsuwqish b wa7dek dima
en: You (f.) don't always shop alone.
My brother shops from the big market.
He doesn't shop at night.
My mother shops early every Friday.

lat: hiya ma kattsuweqsh f had l-blasa
en: She doesn't shop in this place.
We shop every Wednesday.
We don't shop in the rain.
You (pl.) shop well every month.

lat: ntuma ma kattsuwqush mn had s-suq
ar: نتوما ما كتتسوقوش من هاد السوق
en: You (pl.) don't shop from this market.
They always shop in the morning.

lat: l-jiran ma kaytsuwqush f had l-weqt
en: The neighbors don't shop at this time.
I will shop tomorrow morning.

lat: ma ghadish ntsuweq m3a khuya l-yum
ar: ما غاديش نتسوق مع خويا اليوم
en: I am not going to shop with my brother today.
Are you going to shop with us today?

lat: nta ma ghadish ttsuweq f had l-berd
ar: نتا ما غاديش تتسوق فهاد البرد
en: You are not going to shop in this cold.
You (f.) are going to shop with your sister tomorrow.

lat: nti ma ghadish ttsuwqi bla biya
ar: نتي ما غاديش تتسوقي بلا بيا
en: You (f.) are not going to shop without me.

lat: huwa ghadi ytsuweq l d-dar l-lila
en: He is going to shop for the house tonight.
My father is not going to shop tomorrow.
She is going to shop in the afternoon.

lat: khti ma ghadish ttsuweq f had z-z7am
ar: ختي ما غاديش تتسوق فهاد الزحام
en: My sister is not going to shop in this crowd.
We are going to shop for the party tomorrow.
We are not going to shop until Friday.

lat: ntuma ghadi ttsuwqu f s-suq l-usbu3i
en: You (pl.) are going to shop at the weekly market.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish ttsuwqu m3ana l-lila
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تتسوقو معانا الليلة
en: You (pl.) are not going to shop with us tonight.

lat: huma ghadi ytsuwqu f l-marki ghedda
en: They are going to shop at the market tomorrow.

lat: sh-shabab ma ghadish ytsuwqu had s-sebt
ar: الشباب ما غاديش يتسوقو هاد السبت
en: The youth are not going to shop this Saturday.
